title: I Used the Allotment Greenhouse Hours on the Plot Chair Who Camped the Bench

parts.text: I booked the shared greenhouse 10:00–11:00 and at 10:03 chair Mo was still on the potting bench with last night's trays. The door card said: BOOK THE BENCH. SIXTY MINUTES. CLEAR THE TRAYS. I was forty-eight, plot 17, holding a booking slip. Mo did not clear. "Chairs are the glass." I photographed the slip, the card, and the overnight trays. Then I logged a camp. At 10:11 the site secretary asked why Mo's trays were on my hour. I waited where the camera already was. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The site secretary can see overnight trays on the potting bench during my booked hour.

social.video_title: The plot chair camped the greenhouse bench past my booking — Part 1/2
social.description: Allotment greenhouse, a booking slip, and overnight trays. I logged the camp. Would you have waited at the door?

parts.text: Mo called it frost until the secretary asked for the log. I printed the camp, the photo, and the slip. Trays moved. Mo booked a frost hour and told plotters frost was always about optics. Optics is a word chairs use when a tray exists. Hours now have a second line: CHAIRS CLEAR. I keep my sixty. Mo books. The glass finally looks like a booking, not a campsite. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.description: Camp log, cleared bench, and a second line. Was frost ever my slip?
